approval_evidence.quote: This new drug application provides for the use of Myrbetriq (mirabegron), 25 mg and 50 mg, for the treatment of overactive bladder. (FDA approval letter, NDA 202611, signed 06/28/2012)

series_start_reason: Astellas' financial-results library on astellas.com begins with Q1 FY2017 (April-June 2017); earlier quarters (Japan launch of Betanis in 2011, U.S. 2012) are not citable from documents located (searched legacy URL patterns returned 404). The FY2017 Q1 document prints the April-June 2016 quarter only as a prior-year column, with no other FY2016 quarters printed individually.
notes: Printed label is 'Betanis/Myrbetriq/BETMIGA' (Japan, U.S., Europe brand names of mirabegron on one global line; spelled 'Betanis/Myrabetriq/BETMIGA' in some FY2018-FY2019 supplementary documents). Row is in the 'Global' sales-of-major-products table (billions of JPY).
search_log: read https://www.astellas.com/en/investors/financial-results-library (146 PDF links) and cached every financial-results PDF (main release, supplementary documents, presentation, earnings-call scripts); earliest linked quarter is Q1 FY2017 (April-June 2017)
guessed legacy astellas.com/en/ir/library/pdf/... URLs for FY2013-FY2016 documents: all returned 404, so no earlier Astellas document was found
extracted the 'Global' sales-of-major-products table in each quarter's supplementary document (billions of JPY, one decimal) with pdfplumber, the verifier's extractor

where the quarter's own document text layer splits the digits of the row, the same quarter was read from a later document of the same fiscal year, or derived from year-to-date figures (rows are labelled accordingly)
cross-check: for every complete fiscal year the four quarters were summed and compared with the full-year figure on the same table (differences at most 0.2 billion JPY from rounding)
